beats.text: London, 1850. You climb down into the sewers, to hunt for lost coins.

scene.src: commons:Gustave Doré - Wentworth Street Whitechapel - London, a Pilgrimage.jpg

beats.text: You're a tosher. Anything that falls through a drain can be treasure.
Coins, spoons, bits of copper and iron. On a good day you earn more than most workers above you.
But it's illegal without permission, so you go down in secret, with a lantern and a long pole.
Danger one: the tide. When the Thames rises, the tunnels can flood fast.

scene.src: commons:Illustrated London News - print; coloured engraving- Panorama of London and the River Thames - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: Danger two: foul air. It can knock you out, or even catch fire near your lantern.
Danger three: getting lost. Some toshers went down and never came back up.
Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
